description: This source file defines the MobileControlRig class which manages activation of child game objects based on input platform (mobile or not) within Unity. It handles enabling/disabling control rigs, ensures an event system exists, and integrates with Unity editor behaviors.

classes.name: MobileControlRig
classes.description: Manages activation of child objects based on whether mobile input is enabled in the Unity project. Implements editor callback for build target changes.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Checks if an EventSystem exists in the scene at startup, and adds one if missing.

methods.name: CheckEnableControlRig
methods.description: Enables or disables the control rig based on the MOBILE_INPUT define.

methods.name: EnableControlRig
methods.description: Activates or deactivates all child game objects of the control rig.

methods.name: OnActiveBuildTargetChanged
methods.description: Handles logic for when the build target changes in the editor, to re-evaluate control rig state.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Periodically checks whether to enable or disable control rig during editor updates.
